_note: Hand-curated gold CL terms for hECA/uHAF lung labels, assigned from the 50-gene deep marker sets (heca_markers_deep_Lung.json) and NOT from the label string. Where markers contradict the label, the markers decide - so several entries deliberately disagree with the atlas label. 'null' = markers too non-specific to assign a term (abstention), which is a valid curation outcome and must not be scored as a miss.
_disagrees_with_label: Neutrophilic granulocyte (FCN1/CD14/S100A12 = classical monocyte, no FCGR3B/ELANE); Bronchial smooth muscle cell (fibroblast markers, no ACTA2/MYH11/TAGLN); Tuft cell (EOMES/CD160/KLRC1/SH2D1B = NK, no POU2F3/TRPM5); Basal cell (SCGB1A1/SCGB3A2 = club, no KRT5); Epithelial progenitor cell (KRT5/KRT15/KRT17 = basal); Memory CD8 T cell (LEF1/TCF7/SELL/CCR7 = naive); NKT cell (CD8A+CD8B = alpha-beta CD8 T)
